summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD monthly statistical release on new residential construction (dated September 20, 2022, reporting August 2022 data). Relevant to the task: Table 1b provides "Not seasonally adjusted" data for "New Privately-Owned Housing Units Authorized" in the United States. It contributes the specific figure of 136.4 thousand units for August 2022, which is the starting month of the requested 2022/08–2025/05 period. The August 2022 value is marked preliminary ('p'), indicating it may be subject to revision; under the task's rule that the "most recent report shall prevail," this document's figure is superseded by later releases in the collection that contain revised historical data for August 2022. The report also lists data for January through July 2022, but only the August 2022 value falls strictly within the required timeframe.
